title: VTpass vs Ufriends IT — Best Platform for NIN/BVN Slips & VTU in Nigeria
excerpt: VTpass is big on bill payments, but how does it compare to Ufriends IT for NIN/BVN slip printing, data pricing, and identity services? Full honest comparison inside.
keywords: best platform NIN BVN slip Nigeria

sections.content: VTpass is one of the biggest names in Nigerian bill payments and VTU services. It has been around for years and has millions of users. Ufriends IT is a platform that combines VTU with government identity services like NIN/BVN slip printing and modification. If you are wondering which platform gives you better overall value — especially if you also need identity documents — this comparison breaks it down for you.
We will compare both platforms on what they actually offer, where their pricing stands, how they handle identity services, and which one is worth your time and money depending on what you need.
Quick Comparison

VTpass is excellent for bill payments — electricity, cable TV, airtime, data, and motor insurance. It is a well-established platform with native apps and strong brand trust. However, VTpass does not offer NIN or BVN slip printing, identity modification, or CAC registration. Ufriends IT covers all core VTU services and adds full identity services on top. If NIN/BVN services matter to you, Ufriends IT is the clear winner.
VTpass — What It Offers

VTpass (vtpass.com) is a Nigerian platform focused on utility bill payments and VTU services. It offers airtime and data recharge for all major networks, cable TV subscriptions (DStv, GOtv, Startimes), electricity bill payments for various distribution companies, WAEC registration and result checker pins, motor insurance, and bulk SMS. VTpass operates a partner and agent program with commission tiers. The platform has native apps on Google Play and the App Store. Payment options include debit/credit cards, bank transfers, and wallet funding.
Ufriends IT — What It Offers

Ufriends IT (ufriends.com.ng) is a Nigerian VTU and government identity services platform. The VTU side covers data, airtime, cable TV, electricity, exam pins, airtime-to-cash, and bulk SMS. The identity side includes NIN slip printing (Regular, Standard, Premium, VNIN), BVN slip generation (regular and premium plastic), lawful NIN and BVN modification (name, DOB, phone corrections), BVN retrieval by phone number, and CAC business registration. It includes Developer API v1 with Sandbox Mode, SDKs, and webhooks. Wallet funding uses virtual bank accounts with instant auto-credit.
Feature Comparison Table
Data and Airtime Pricing

VTpass pricing is generally at face value for standard users, with discounts available to partners and API users at higher commission tiers. The platform charges convenience fees on some transactions. Ufriends IT offers wholesale-level data pricing across all networks from the start, with better rates at higher account tiers (Agent, Vendor). There are no convenience fees on data and airtime.

For users who buy data frequently, Ufriends IT's pricing model tends to be more favourable because the wholesale rates are accessible even at the basic account level. VTpass's strength is its wide acceptance and the ability to pay with debit/credit cards directly, which Ufriends IT does not currently support — wallet funding via bank transfer is the primary method.
NIN and BVN Slip Services

This is the biggest difference between the two platforms. VTpass does not offer any NIN or BVN services. It is not designed for identity document management. If you need to print your NIN slip, retrieve your BVN, or correct errors on your NIN or BVN, VTpass cannot help.

Ufriends IT was built with identity services as a core feature. You can print NIN slips in four formats — Regular (basic table format), Standard (ID card with QR code), Premium (premium card design), and VNIN (verification-as-a-service report). BVN slips come in regular and premium plastic card formats. If your bank ever rejected your ID because of a name mismatch or wrong date of birth, you can submit modification requests for both NIN and BVN directly from the platform. You can also retrieve a forgotten BVN using just your phone number.
Bill Payments and Utility Services

VTpass has one of the most comprehensive bill payment systems in Nigeria. It covers a wide range of electricity distribution companies, cable TV providers, motor insurance, and educational payments. This is where VTpass truly shines — it was originally built as a payment platform. Ufriends IT covers electricity bills for major DISCOs, cable TV (DStv, GOtv, Startimes), and exam pins. VTpass has broader coverage for niche utility payments like motor insurance.
Developer and Business Features

VTpass offers a multi-tier partner program (Terminal, Widget, Affiliate, API) with commissions ranging from 2-5% depending on the service and partner level. Their API is well-documented for bill payment integrations. Ufriends IT's Developer API v1 includes Sandbox Mode for risk-free testing, Node.js and PHP SDKs for faster integration, and automated webhooks. If you are building a fintech product that needs both VTU and identity verification features, Ufriends IT's API is more comprehensive.
Pros and Cons
VTpass

items: ✅ One of the most established bill payment platforms in Nigeria
❌ No NIN or BVN services whatsoever
❌ No identity modification or CAC registration
❌ Standard pricing (no wholesale data discounts for basic users)

items: ✅ NIN slip printing (4 formats) and BVN slip generation

✅ Wholesale data pricing from basic tier
✅ Full Developer API with Sandbox and SDKs
✅ No convenience fees on VTU transactions

❌ No motor insurance or niche utility payments

sections.content: Which Platform Should You Use?

VTpass is the better choice if you primarily need a comprehensive bill payment platform with card payment support and do not care about identity services. It has the widest utility coverage and strong brand trust built over many years.

Ufriends IT is the better choice if you want cheaper wholesale data rates, NIN/BVN slip printing, identity modification services, and developer-friendly API tools — all from one platform. In Nigeria, where identity documents are required for everything from opening a bank account to getting a new SIM card, having these services alongside your VTU is a significant advantage.
Many users actually use both — VTpass for niche bill payments and Ufriends IT for data, airtime, and identity services. There is no rule that says you must pick only one.
Need cheap data plus NIN/BVN slip printing in one place? Sign up free at ufriends.com.ng and get started in under 60 seconds.
Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: Can I print my NIN slip on VTpass?
items.a: No. VTpass does not offer NIN slip printing or any identity document services. To print NIN slips in Nigeria, you can use Ufriends IT which supports Regular, Standard, Premium, and VNIN slip formats.

items.q: Is VTpass cheaper than Ufriends IT for data?
items.a: VTpass typically charges face value for standard users, while Ufriends IT offers wholesale-level pricing even at the basic account tier. For data purchases specifically, Ufriends IT tends to be more affordable.
VTpass may charge convenience fees on certain transactions. Ufriends IT does not charge convenience fees on data, airtime, or bill payment transactions.

items.q: Can VTpass modify my BVN or NIN?
items.a: No. VTpass does not offer BVN or NIN modification services. Ufriends IT provides lawful modifications for name, date of birth, and phone number on both BVN and NIN.

items.q: Which platform has a better mobile app?
items.a: VTpass has native apps on both Android and iOS, which provides a smoother mobile experience. Ufriends IT uses a PWA (Progressive Web App) that works on all devices when added to the home screen but lacks native app store presence.

items.q: Can I use both platforms at the same time?
items.a: Yes. Many users use VTpass for niche bill payments and motor insurance, and Ufriends IT for data, airtime, and NIN/BVN identity services. You can maintain wallets on both platforms.
